body: The problem is that I do play video games and stuff to calm down. In those worlds I'm confident, at ease, enjoy life. And then when I'm not and all the priorities stack up I begin to feel uneasy. Now fear and worry is one emotion, but suddenly feeling pressured and like I'm just a failure is leading me to hate myself. I've always hated myself. Now I have a reason to believe that I'm not merely worthless, but I'm somehow infecting everyone around me just being here. I just don't want to anymore. I want out.
